criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Symptomatic respiratory tract infection
- Negative SARS-CoV-2 test before spiroergometry. 
-  Age ≥18 years. 
- Regular exercise activity with participation in
 competitions
Exclusion criteria:
- Known underlying pulmonary or cardiac disease defined as heart failure with preserved or reduced pump function, myocarditis, known coronary artery disease, obstructive restrictive lung disease
- Positive SARS-COV-2 test after clinical symptoms.
- Lack of consent
- Pregnancy
- Age<18 yrs.
